dataset: Treatment modality (治療手法) controlled vocabulary
policy: Canonical modality.* ids (D17). modality.* records do not exist yet — this is the vocabulary and the gap map, same approach as symptom_taxonomy.json (D14 build order).
觀察到的生活型態／暴露資料一律不得自動轉為 TCM 證型或診斷（D17 §6）；本檔案雖為治療手法而非觀察值，仍遵守同一原則——modality.* 只記錄『做了什麼』，不推論證型。
疑似暴露（suspected）不得自動升級為確診（confirmed）——與本檔案無直接關聯，一併聲明以維持五檔詞彙檔案政策一致。
IDs are ASCII (D10). Adding a modality is a schema change: this file, then the visit form, then any validator that checks modality.* ids.
applies_to: Visit-level treatment records captured under a future modality.* field
